landing.title: Your classes, in sync
landing.body: Lecturers set up a class once and share a code. Students join with their matricule and see every course of their class.
landing.lecturerBody: Find or add your school, open a shared class and add your courses to it.
landing.studentBody: Join your class once with its code and your matricule. Every course of the class shows up on its own.

verifyBanner.title: Verify your email address
verifyBanner.body: Open the link we sent to {email} to start creating and joining classes.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lecturerEmptyBody: Create a class at your school, or join a colleague's class with their lecturer code.
dashboard.studentEmptyBody: Ask your lecturer for the class code, then join with your matricule.

dashboard.noCourses: No courses in this class yet.

join.title: Join a class
join.lecturerDescription: Enter the lecturer code a colleague shared with you. You can then add your own courses to the class.

join.matriculeHint: As written on your student card.

student.title: Check in
student.description: Enter the code your lecturer shows on the screen.
student.emptyBody: When your lecturer opens a check-in, it appears here. This page updates by itself.
student.codeHint: 6 letters and digits. It changes every minute.
student.codeRequired: Enter the code shown on the screen.

student.forbidden: You're not on this course's list, so you can't check in here.
student.emailUnverified: Verify your email address before checking in.

refusal.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes for this check-in. Ask your lecturer to mark you present.
refusal.wrong_code: That code isn't right. It changes every minute, so enter the one on the screen now.
refusal.location_required: This check-in needs your location. Allow location access for this site in your browser, then try again.
refusal.location_imprecise: Your location isn't precise enough. Turn on location services or move near a window, then try again.
refusal.off_campus: You don't seem to be on campus. Check-in only works from the school.

student.noSessions: No attendance has been taken for this course yet.
